description_expanded:
This Florida vacation rental has 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and comes with the seaside elegance of Alys Beach. Located near many of the community’s most famous amenities, including Caliza Pool, this home is the perfect setting for a memorable beach vacation. The great room opens to a courtyard with a fountain and connects to a covered outdoor living room with a fireplace, flat screen TV, and grill overlooking Arboleda Park. On the upper level is a grand primary bedroom also overlooking the park. In addition, there are 2 more spacious bedrooms and a living area that connects to the bunk rooms. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 46 Spiceberry Alley. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
